name: agentic
description: Track work as tasks: associate the Slack threads, GitHub issues/PRs, and Google Drive docs that feed them, spin up git worktrees to work on them, and let a coding agent keep a current summary and next-steps list.

paragraphs: Track work as tasks, associate the Slack threads, GitHub issues/PRs, and Google Drive docs that feed them, spin up git worktrees to work on them, and let a coding agent keep a current summary and next-steps list so resuming is quick.
(opencode acp / opencode2 acp) and pi (pi-acp) are preconfigured; add more in Settings.
Responsive down to phones: the task list becomes an off-canvas drawer and the detail view stacks into a single column.
features: Backend: FastAPI + SQLModel (SQLite), single-user and local-first.
Frontend: Vue 3 + Vite, built as an installable PWA and served by the API.

whatItDoes.text: Track work as tasks, associate the Slack threads, GitHub issues/PRs, and Google Drive docs that feed them, spin up git worktrees to work on them, and let a coding agent keep a current summary and next-steps list so resuming is quick.

requirements.text: A merged PR is only offered a change record when you authored it (the login in Settings → Identity, else the authenticated gh account); a PR someone else wrote is not your change to record.
